description: This file defines the 'Minimum' class within the PHPSpreadsheet library, specifically for statistical calculations such as 'MIN' and 'MINA'. It provides implementations for computing the smallest value(s) from a list of inputs, handling different data types and error conditions.

classes.name: Minimum
classes.description: A class providing statistical minimum functions, including 'MIN' and 'MINA', for use within spreadsheets.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the smallest numeric value from the provided arguments, ignoring non-numeric and error values.

methods.name: minA
methods.description: Returns the smallest value considering numbers, text, and logical values, including type adjustments.
